data.content:
I sent one dispute, for DD-51152. The owner skipped the other three drafts (DD-51131, DD-51115, DD-51123), and I did not retry them.

**Sent**
- **DD-51152 ($28.40, 90% win probability):** The ticket lists only Veg Momo (Steamed) and Samosa Chaat, not the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. The dispute says plainly that the ticket shows what was prepared, not what was packed.

**Drafted but skipped by the owner**
- **DD-51131 ($19.00, 77%):** The ticket lists Chicken Momo (Steamed). Ready 19:31, picked up 19:34. DD-51131 is a wrong-item claim, and my memory has no similar past cases, so no lesson applied.
- **DD-51115 ($17.50, 70%):** The ticket lists Jhol Momo. Ready 12:55, picked up 12:58. One lesson applied: "doordash:missing_item [pickup_handoff+1|ticket_lists_item+1] won". Two of the three similar past cases won. The loss involved a side item not itemised on the ticket, which doesn't apply here.
- **DD-51123 ($14.25, 82%):** The ticket lists Veg Momo (Fried). Ready 18:36, picked up 18:40. The recalled history was only a partial match: "Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won."
- Three claims in this payout came from one customer account (DD-51123, DD-51131, DD-51140). I kept that out of the drafts so they don't characterise the customer.

**Weak**
- **DD-51102 ($46.80, 35%):** This is the largest deduction, but there is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't compare the claimed Chicken Momo Party Tray to the order. **Action for you:** send a photo of the ticket for order DD-51102 and I'll re-run the evidence check.

**Not pursued**
- **DD-51140 ($13.75) and DD-51160 ($9.50):** Both are at 60% but weren't checked, because they fell outside the top 5 by queue order.
- **DD-51171 ($11.00, 15%):** Skip, because the odds are too low to be worth your time.
- **DD-50980 ($0.00):** Skip, because the deadline passed 11 days ago and the amount is $0.

**Next deadline:** 2026-11-24, 10 days away, for the cases still open.

I saved the case folder to `/plan.md`.
